name: Face-Homology Formula for Literal-Ideal Betti Numbers
statement: Let $F$ be a positive-dimensional coordinate face with nonempty trace $V=C\cap F$, and let $\mathcal B(C,F)$ be the simplicial complex of subsets of $V$ lying in a proper coordinate face of $F$. If $u_F$ is the literal label of $F$, then for $i\geq1$, $\beta_{i,u_F}(J_C)=\dim_k\widetilde H_{i-1}(\mathcal B(C,F);k)$. Every positive-step Betti label arises from a face this way. Thus nonzero homology for an $r$-face certifies $\nu_k(C)\geq\lceil r/i\rceil-1$.
proof: The $u_F$ strand of the Taylor resolution is the relative augmented chain complex of the full simplex on $V$ modulo the subsets whose least common multiple strictly divides $u_F$, which are precisely $\mathcal B(C,F)$. Contractibility of the full simplex gives the displayed reduced homology. Every squarefree least common multiple of literal generators determines a coordinate face.
